source.read_scope: UniProt catalytic activity annotations and their evidence pointers; cited primary papers not independently reviewed

interpretation.boundary: Generic tetrahydropteridine/dihydropteridine annotations are not an exact biopterin substrate assignment. NADH evidence is not interchangeable with NADPH evidence. Source right-to-left means reduction in these source equations, not right-to-left in the oppositely oriented catalog equation. No Cannabis activity or physiological oxidation is established.
next_actions: Retrieve primary assay methods to establish exact substrate stereochemistry and NADPH-specific activity independently of the generic annotation.

Screen the complete pinned Cannabis proteome against generic pteridine reductase references in a separate specificity-unverified hypothesis class; do not promote hits into the exact-reaction model solely from homology.
Test authentic quinonoid dihydrobiopterin and tetrahydrobiopterin with NADH and NADPH separately, including both reaction directions and enzyme-free controls.
